hooks.name: Rust core: test on save
hooks.description: When any Rust source in rebellion-core changes, run the test suite so snapshot decoding and arc aggregation never silently break.

action.prompt: A Rust file in rebellion-core changed. Run `cd rebellion-core && cargo test`. If anything fails, summarize the failing test and the likely cause, and propose a minimal fix. Do not change public WASM API signatures without flagging it.
